Subject: Private VPC pricing - discovery recap and next steps

Alex / Procurement team — great talking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today's discovery call: 

- Key notes from call:
  - Current expected token volume: ~10-20M tokens/month (initial).
  - Projection: 80-100M tokens/month within 12 months if pilot converts.
  - Primary use: production inference for payments fraud detection + internal embeddings for search.
  - Must run in customer-managed VPC (private control plane), bring-your-own-KMS for keys.

- Pricing items we need to confirm to put together a formal quote: 
  1) Confirm target budget range (monthly or annual). Helpful if you can share an approximate $/month range or budget band.
  2) Confirm expected environments to be supported under the Private/VPC deployment (e.g., prod, staging, dev, test).
  3) Support tier preference: Standard (business hours) vs Premium (24/7 + named SLA).
  4) Licensing model preference: capacity-based commit vs hybrid (platform license + usage). If you have procurement constraints (PO terms, net-45/60) flag them now.
  5) Any regulatory or audit items beyond SOC 2 we should include in the SOW.

Attached are the draft pricing worksheet and a short SOW template for Private/VPC deployments (attachment: Redwood_Private_VPC_Pricing_Proposal_Q1_2027.pdf).

Next steps
- If you can confirm items 1-4 above, I will produce a formal quote with 3 pricing bands (pilot, scale, committed annual) + example unit economics (target $/1M tokens) by EOD Tuesday.
- Marissa (cc) will follow up to schedule a technical deep dive next week if you'd like to validate networking/infra details.

Thanks — speak soon.

Alex / Procurement — thanks for the details. Below is a clear, illustrative pricing breakdown to help your finance model. This is a draft — final pricing will be in the formal quote once you confirm environments & support tier.

High-level pricing (Private / VPC deployment) — illustrative bands
- Pilot (10-25M tokens/mo) — Short-term pilot pricing, month-to-month:
  - Platform license (one-time onboarding): $40,000 (includes deployment & one-week runbook + training).
  - Usage unit economics (Private): $2,000 per 1M tokens (examples below).
  - Support: Standard included for pilot; Premium available at +25% on license and +20% on monthly usage.

- Scale (25-100M tokens/mo) — committed monthly pricing (3-12 month commitments):
  - Option A: Capacity commit model — monthly reserved capacity with lower unit price: $1,100-$1,600 per 1M tokens depending on commit size (tiered).
  - Option B: Hybrid (platform license + discounted usage) — platform license $25,000 (annual), usage at $900-$1,300 per 1M tokens at scale.

Examples (to hit your target budget):
- If you do 10M tokens in pilot at $2,000 /1M -> $20,000/month + amortized onboarding; fits within your ~$30k-$60k band when you include other infra/SE hours.
- If you scale to 80M tokens with a committed capacity at $1,200 /1M -> $96,000/month (we'd structure an annual commit discount or blended model to reach your target).

Notes on per-1M token economics: Private deployments include customer-specific infra, KMS, and additional R&D/ops costs; unit price will therefore be higher than hosted API. That said, with multi-month or annual commits and a reserved capacity model we can drive unit economics well below the pilot $2K/1M range.

Questions for you to finalize the quote (please confirm):
- Final list of environments to license for (you mentioned prod/staging/dev = 3). Will QA be in scope for the initial contract?
- Preferred billing cadence (monthly vs annual pre-pay).
- Procurement contact for PO and preferred payment terms.

I'm attaching a draft quote and a short example PO/terms PDF. Once procurement confirms we can produce a formal quote and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

If helpful, Marissa can run a quick cost-sizing call next week to map your token profile to instance sizing/quantization and show how caching and batching will impact unit economics.

\u0014
